d: Pharmaceutical trader Rajiv Rangila, described by the Anti-Corruption Branch (ACB) as one of the alleged masterminds of the Delhi government medical procurement scam, was arrested after he surrendered. He had been absconding since June. In its chargesheet, the ACB pegs the loss to the public exchequer at Rs 842 crore. It alleges that a tender for two X-ray machines became an order for 448, and that machines sold elsewhere for Rs 14.9 lakh were bought at Rs 37.8 lakh each.
